champion: Renal cell carcinoma with vascular pedicle
ordered_diagnoses: Renal cell carcinoma with vascular pedicle
Renal cell carcinoma with tumor thrombus
Renal cell carcinoma with inferior vena cava thrombosis

facts.raw_span: A 66-year-old woman
a history of endometrioid endometrial carcinoma
abdominal and pelvic pain
Physical examination was unremarkable
a creatinine level of 0.81 mg dl–1
laboratory studies, including a creatinine level, were within normal limits
a right renal mass with areas of fat attenuation located in the upper pole
creating a defect in the renal parenchyma
visible vessels extending into the renal cortex, a finding known as a “renal parenchymal vascular pedicle”
a fatty tumor thrombus within the right renal vein extending to its confluence with the inferior vena cava
No other masses or enlarged lymph nodes were identified

aliases: Renal cell carcinoma with renal parenchymal vascular pedicle
concepts.preferred_label: Renal cell carcinoma with vascular pedicle
concepts.why: The presence of a right renal mass with areas of fat attenuation and visible vessels extending into the renal cortex, known as a renal parenchymal vascular pedicle, suggests renal cell carcinoma with vascular pedicle.

aliases: Renal cell carcinoma with fatty tumor thrombus
concepts.preferred_label: Renal cell carcinoma with tumor thrombus
concepts.why: The presence of a right renal mass with areas of fat attenuation and a fatty tumor thrombus within the right renal vein extending to its confluence with the inferior vena cava suggests renal cell carcinoma with tumor thrombus.
The presence of a right renal mass with areas of fat attenuation suggests angiomyolipoma.
The presence of a fatty tumor thrombus within the right renal vein extending to its confluence with the inferior vena cava suggests renal vein thrombosis.

aliases: Metastatic endometrial cancer to the kidney
Endometrial carcinoma metastasis to the kidney
concepts.preferred_label: Metastatic endometrial carcinoma to the kidney
concepts.why: The patient's history of endometrioid endometrial carcinoma and the presence of a right renal mass suggest metastatic endometrial carcinoma to the kidney.

aliases: Renal cell carcinoma with tumor thrombus in the inferior vena cava
concepts.preferred_label: Renal cell carcinoma with inferior vena cava thrombosis
concepts.why: The presence of a right renal mass with areas of fat attenuation and a fatty tumor thrombus within the right renal vein extending to its confluence with the inferior vena cava suggests renal cell carcinoma with inferior vena cava thrombosis.
The presence of a right renal mass with areas of fat attenuation suggests liposarcoma of the kidney.
The presence of a right renal mass with areas of fat attenuation suggests renal hamartoma.

rationales.F02: History of endometrioid endometrial carcinoma increases the likelihood of metastasis to the kidney.
rationales.F07: The presence of a right renal mass with areas of fat attenuation is highly suggestive of a renal tumor.
rationales.F09: The presence of a renal parenchymal vascular pedicle is a characteristic feature of renal cell carcinoma.
rationales.F10: The presence of a fatty tumor thrombus within the right renal vein is highly suggestive of a renal tumor with venous invasion.
